author: ThadRocks123
body:
I was banned from this server for hacking. I won't lie.... I was hacking. I have been playing on this server for roughly 1-2 years and love the Break the monument. I would like to be unbanned and will never hack again. If I do hack again (which I won't) I will not appeal the infraction because I deserved it. I would like to be unbanned from the server. Thank you for your time.


 -ThadRocks123
